title: Recompute Part B on three operating systems and two Pythons, and compare decisions and numbers separately

why.the_remainder_it_addresses: Part B's finding carries [R]_platform: computed on one Linux container from source matrices that differ in the last ulp from the platform they were frozen on. A result on one platform is not evidence about another; CLAUDE.md rule 7 says so, and the CI file's own comment records that a Windows defect was once found by a reviewer and not by anything here.
why.what_existing_ci_does_not_do: tests/test_part_b_result.py re-applies the frozen outcome function to the COMMITTED map rows. That shows the function is portable. It does not recompute anything, so it says nothing about whether the computation reproduces.

procedure_per_platform.references: artifacts/r6k_w1_part_b/map_rows.json and crossing.json must be byte-identical to their blobs at C_raw de60129f7520672f6391ddd69d9f68bb3082a7b0; the R6N licence must pass verify_r6n_licence (committed digest, evidence, and the bytes being executed).
procedure_per_platform.recompute: build_substituted_fork(held-out grid, licence=R6N licence) -> plan_protocol(Part B effective protocol digest) -> execute_protocol -> the runner's extract_map_rows -> validate_map_rows -> part_b_outcome. Nothing is written under artifacts/r6k_w1_part_b/.
procedure_per_platform.extraction_binding: extract_map_rows must be the function that ran at C_exec e96fa24: its source segment is compared with the same function's source in the runner blob at that commit
procedure_per_platform.compare_decision: the outcome dictionary EXACTLY equal to the committed one (outcome, reason, clean_first_pass, noisy_first_passes, disagreements), and every one of the 80 differential cells' probability and information pass flags identical
procedure_per_platform.compare_numbers: aionq.semantic_reproduction.compare_results over the 160 map rows at 1e-10 -- R6k-W1's committed tolerance, never widened -- with discrete fields exact and no row or field on one side only

verdicts.REPRODUCED: decision identical AND numbers within tolerance
verdicts.OUTCOME_ONLY: decision identical, numbers NOT within tolerance
verdicts.INVALID: a reference fails byte verification, the licence is refused, or the computation raises

frozen_rule.why_two_layers: a platform's linear algebra can move a number past 1e-10 without moving any pass/fail flag, or move a flag without moving many numbers. Reporting one verdict would hide which happened.
frozen_rule.ci_gate: a dedicated job per platform exits zero only on REPRODUCED. Its full report is printed to the job log and uploaded whatever the outcome.

platforms.claim_rule: a platform/Python pair is claimed reproduced ONLY if its dedicated job ran and finished green. A job that did not run, was cancelled, or ran on a runner that refused to start is a gap, not a pass.

prediction: REPRODUCED on all six. At risk: macOS uses a different BLAS/LAPACK, and numbers may move past 1e-10 there; that would read OUTCOME_ONLY and is a result, not a defect to be tuned away.
kill_conditions: the tolerance is 1e-10 and may not be widened after any job has run

no platform's verdict is re-derived, re-run selectively, or reclassified after its report is seen; a re-run of an entire run is permitted only for an infrastructure failure that never reached the reproduction step, and is recorded
nothing is written under artifacts/r6k_w1_part_b/, and Part B's committed result is not altered
OUTCOME_ONLY and NOT_REPRODUCED are reported as such
evidence_ceiling: PORTABILITY of a deterministic computation across the CI matrix. Not independent witnessing: the producer, the workflow and the comparison are all this development line's. Not a claim about any platform outside the matrix.
typed_remainders_declared_in_advance: [R]_same_lineage: CI runs code this line wrote; a second party recomputing is still absent.
[R]_runner_images: 'ubuntu-latest', 'windows-latest' and 'macos-latest' are moving images; the report records each job's actual platform string and library versions.
[R]_matrix_only: three operating systems and two Pythons on one architecture family each.
stop_condition: Stop after one CI run's six reproduction jobs have finished and their reports are recorded in artifacts/r6o_part_b_reproduction/reproduction.json.
